about: 完璧归赵 (WanbiFilm), sound cues from STORYBOARD.md's sound lines. Every cue is tied to a NAMED beat (scripts/kit/sound/cuesheet.py; Wanbi adds HOLD.<who> = the jade chip's changes, TAG_OUT, TAG_FLIP, PIC.HOOK.<wind|strike|hit|rewave> = shots/hook.ts FEINT1, PIC.A.x = shots/segA_ov.ts T.x); expand_cues.py unrolls the 'series' lines and stops anything that would run past the film's end (the film does NOT loop). Segment A is animated: its cues follow the picture's own beats (PIC.A, PIC.HOOK); segments B to E follow beats.ts (HIT / TAG / BEAT / SHOT / CAP), which their builders must land on. Levels (rel) are dB against the narration's loud syllables, as Hongmen: spot effects -8 to -16, beds -24 to -28. Beds: one gain per stretch, never ducking: the hall (shots 1-2, 7a-11 to the feint, 12a-15, 17a-22), the Zhao court (3-6, 23a-23b), the road at dusk (16a-16b). No music.

drone.note: the frozen standoff at the pillar (shots 1-2, again 831-896)

clang.note: the cauldron's bronze clang and short ring (round 2), over the low thud of cauldron_1
